metadata.confidence_note: Native OpenAI distributions and separate confidence are retained; score accuracy uses posterior argmax, not rounded mean.

jevbench.scope: published public corpus only; not the current sealed-inclusive leaderboard
jevbench.language: not annotated by the published corpus; no translations added
jevbench.structured_state: serialized as Unicode JSON with sorted keys for every adapter
jevbench.calibration: GLiNER is label-only; Copilot probabilities are one-sample vote shares, not native likelihoods

metadata.context_policy: complete text and typed questions; no client-side truncation

openai_billing.note: Base-rate estimate on reported total input tokens, including warmups; not an invoice. Regional premiums, long-context multipliers and account-specific adjustments are excluded. Copilot AI credits are not applicable.
